name: q-a-database_v2
description: Ek smart Q&A chatbot: admin backend se questions/answers add karta hai, students sirf apna sawaal type karte hain aur unhe fuzzy + synonym matching se best answer milta hai. Kisi bhi Node.js-supporting host (Render, Railway, VPS, cPanel with Node, Heroku, etc.) par chal sakta hai — sirf MongoDB connection chahiye (MongoDB Atlas ka free tier bhi kaam karega).
